limitations: Analysis is passive: TLS 1.3 encrypts the server certificate, so chain validation is only possible for TLS <= 1.2 handshakes (or resumed-free full handshakes).

Drift results are only as good as the baseline: a baseline captured during an insecure period encodes that insecurity as normal.

executive_summary: 167 email sessions across 7 service endpoint(s) were reconstructed from securemail_drift.pcap (3103 packets, 167 TCP streams). The overall cryptographic security posture is 40/100 (grade F).
47 actionable finding(s): 9 critical, 15 high, 17 medium, 6 low (12 informational).
15 session(s) carried mail without any transport encryption; 8 exposed mailbox credentials in cleartext.
20 TLS session(s) negotiated a deprecated protocol version (< TLS 1.2).
The ML engine flagged 30 anomalous session(s) (IsolationForest).
Baseline comparison: drift detected - 12 drift item(s), drift score 100/100.
